title: The White Devil
summary: "The White Devil" by John Webster is a tragedy first performed in 1612. When a powerful duke falls violently in love with the married Vittoria Corombona, her scheming brother facilitates their illicit affair. Murders follow, then trials, imprisonment, and exile.
